New Members
Monthly signups show the number of new members joining Collaboratory, reflecting platform growth trends. The cumulative view illustrates total membership over time.


















Longterm Retention
Longterm retention measures the proportion of members who have logged in at least once every 90 days over the past 12 months, highlighting consistent participation. Currently, 384 out of 1977 members (19.4%) does not meet this criterion, falling short of the target of ≥ 30%.

Geographic Reach
Members are connecting from 62 countries, based on IP address data. This provides a practical proxy for member distribution, though it may differ from self-reported country of residence. Data may reflect variance in locations due to travel or VPN use.











Regional Reach
All WHO regions are represented among Collaboratory members. The charts show the percentage of members in each region, as well as the distribution of represented countries across regions.




















Institutions
Collaboratory members come from 300+ institutions worldwide, based on email domain data. The chart shows the proportion of members with WHO-affiliated addresses (@who.int) compared with other institutions. While WHO staff make up a significant share, the platform also includes a broader network of global health professionals and organizations.











Disciplines
Member disciplinary information is currently unreported. Collecting data on members’ professional roles and expertise is planned to provide insights into the range of disciplines represented across the Collaboratory community.


Gender Distribution
Gender information for members is currently unreported. Collecting these data will help monitor diversity and inclusivity across the Collaboratory community.

Active Members
596 out of 1977 users were active, which is 30.1% of the community. The target for this indicator is set as ≥ 30%.
The proportion of active members reflects users who logged in at least once within the past 90 days, based on weekly snapshots. Members who have not logged in during that 90-day window are considered inactive (dormant or uninterested).











Posting Activity
1.1% of members posted at least once in the most recent month.
Posting activity tracks sustained member interaction with the platform by measuring the proportion of users who post at least once per month through Collaboratory channels.





The volume of posts, likes, and topics reflects total community activity over time.




















Engagement
Monthly engagement metrics provide an overview of user activity on the forum. These include total and new user counts, along with averages for user activity.Users are classified by recency of activity:

Active: last seen within 90 days
Dormant: last seen 91–180 days ago
Uninterested: last seen more than 180 days ago

Engagement intensity is assessed based on the average time a user spends reading per month, normalized by account age, enabling comparison across all users. Based on this measure, users are categorized as:

Highly Engaged: 15 or more minutes per month
Moderately Engaged: between 2 and 15 minutes per month
Barely Engaged: less than 2 minutes per month

title: Collaboratory Report
text:
This web-based report serves as the central resource for monitoring Collaboratory’s key performance indicators (KPIs) and platform metrics. Designed for streamlined, data-driven decision-making, it allows the Secretariat to track progress against targets, identify trends, and extract actionable insights. All metrics are updated weekly, and all visualizations are structured for clarity and easy inclusion in presentations, reports, or strategic communications.

Overview




  
    Number of Members
    1977
  

  

  
    Number of Networks and CoPs
    24
  


As of 2026-08-10, Collaboratory brings together 1977 members across 2 networks and 22 communities of practice, connecting from 62 countries and 300+ institutions worldwide.
Over the past month, 89 new members have joined the platform, contributing to ongoing growth and engagement.


Key Performance Indicators
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) provide a standardized framework to monitor and evaluate progress. Indicators that meet current targets are shown in green. For each KPI, you can explore trends and detailed breakdowns in the subsequent report sections by clicking on the squares and hovering over elements to view definitions and targets. Some indicators are currently unreported, but they are included to highlight areas for future data collection.
